bukti: This study is to improve the sorting efficiency of string tomatoes, and solve its false detection and false detection.
provides accurate information on the location of single fruit and the quantity of the whole string of fruit for post natal string tomato sorters.

bukti: Images of the peach and apple trees during the blossom period were acquired using a color camera from two sides, east and west.
An image processing algorithm to detect and count the blossoms was developed.
A fruit yield prediction equation that uses the blossoms counted from the east and west images was also derived.

bukti: We present a novel piecewise incremental structure from motion technique to register and reconstruct the apples which is used for extracting count and diameter information.
We validate our approach by presenting results from multiple field trials.

bukti: a simple, online, real-time tracking-by-detection pipeline for precision agriculture based only on motion information
At the end we compute the IoU with the current detection to perform the association and update the state of the tracklets.
it is important to not lose tracks, otherwise the same grape bunch gets counted more than once
catatan: Pelacak berbasis gerak saja: Kalman filter dengan kompensasi gerak kamera (optical flow Lucas-Kanade, transformasi afin), IoU, dan algoritme Hungarian. Tidak ada hitungan tandan yang dilaporkan atau dibandingkan dengan acuan; evaluasi hanya metrik identitas terhadap anotasi MOT. Kamera RealSense D435i dipakai, tetapi depth tidak digunakan dalam metode.
